s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive respiratory distress with weight loss and systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Bilateral vesicular breathing with diffuse rhonchi on lung auscultation
Innumerable ill-defined nodular opacities within both lungs on CT Chest
Marked FDG-avid uptake at the lung lesion on PET scan
key_facts: Medical history of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
Bilateral vesicular breathing with diffuse rhonchi on lung auscultation
Respiratory viral panel, SARS-CoV-2 PCR, fungal pneumonia work-up were negative
QuantiFERON TB test, hepatitis panel, and HIV were nonreactive
CT Chest showed innumerable ill-defined nodular opacities within both lungs
PET scan showed marked FDG-avid uptake at the lung lesion, right neck lymph node, and left acetabular bone marrow
CT-guided lung biopsy revealed patchy areas of large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis

shortlist.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patchy areas of large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis on CT-guided lung biopsy, consistent with lymphoma

shortlist.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Infiltration of lung parenchyma by malignant neoplasm with mixed inflammatory infiltrate and necrosis, suggestive of lymphomatoid granulomatosis

shortlist.label: Primary pulmonary lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of malignant neoplasm in lung parenchyma with lymphoid cells, consistent with primary pulmonary lymphoma

shortlist.label: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Marked nuclear pleomorphism with atypical mitotic figures and vascular involvement, suggestive of anaplastic large cell lymphoma

shortlist.label: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic inflammation and weight loss, with lymphoid cells and necrosis on biopsy, consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with worsening dyspnea, unintentional weight loss, and a lung biopsy showing large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis, along with the CT chest findings of innumerable ill-defined nodular opacities and a right hilar mass, are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. The PET scan showing marked FDG-avid uptake at multiple sites also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
rejected.why: While lymphomatoid granulomatosis can present with similar lung findings, it is typically associated with Epstein-Barr virus infection and often has a more gradual onset.

rejected.label: Primary pulmonary lymphoma
rejected.why: Primary pulmonary lymphoma is a rare entity that typically presents with more localized disease, whereas this patient has widespread involvement.

rejected.label: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma often has a distinct immunophenotypic profile and may present with systemic symptoms, but the biopsy findings in this case are more consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma typically presents with systemic symptoms, lymphadenopathy, and a distinct immunophenotypic profile, which is not consistent with this patient's presentation.
